# Haonuo Machinery

> Shandong Haonuo Machinery Equipment Group Co., Ltd. is a hydraulic oil press manufacturer based in Qingzhou, Shandong, China, producing hydraulic oil press machines since 2010. Factory-direct equipment for cold press and hot press of coconut, sesame, groundnut, mustard, tea seed and 50+ other oil seeds, exporting to 50+ countries. Main market regions: Middle East, Africa, South Asia, Southeast Asia.

Main site: https://www.hydoilpress.com
Group site: https://grainocraft.com
Contact: info@hydoilpress.com

Site languages: English (/), French (/fr), Arabic (/ar), Indonesian (/id)

## Products

- [Hydraulic Oil Press Machine](https://www.hydoilpress.com/products/hydraulic-oil-press): Flagship hydraulic oil press, 100 kg per batch, supports hot press and cold press, 1-year warranty
- [Cold Press Oil Machine](https://www.hydoilpress.com/cold-press-oil-machine): Cold pressing below 60°C to help preserve nutrients and flavor for premium oils, includes hydraulic cold press models
- [Large-Barrel Hydraulic Oil Press](https://www.hydoilpress.com/products/large-barrel-hydraulic-oil-press): Large-capacity barrel (630mm diameter) designed for palm fruit pulp and high-volume commercial pressing
- [Seed Processing Equipment](https://www.hydoilpress.com/products/seed-processing-equipment): Cleaning and crushing equipment for oil seeds
- [Roasting & Steaming Equipment](https://www.hydoilpress.com/products/roasting-steaming-equipment): Heat treatment equipment before pressing
- [Filtration & Refining Equipment](https://www.hydoilpress.com/products/filtration-refining-equipment): Crude oil filtration and refining

## Facts

- Founded: 2010
- Facility: 2,000 m² owned workshop in Qingzhou, Weifang, Shandong, China
- Batch capacity: 100 kg per batch (hydraulic oil press)
- Pressing time: 40-90 minutes per batch, varies by seed type
- Supported seeds: 50+ oil seeds including coconut, sesame, groundnut, mustard, tea seed, walnut
- Shipping: Worldwide export, experienced with ports in 50+ countries
- Palm oil: Specialized large-barrel solution for palm fruit pulp, low-temperature pressing (30–40°C) to preserve carotene, serving clients in Nigeria and across Africa
